digest.component_or_area: completion-recovery bounded context and close-gate failure messaging
propositions: A ticket with 34,282–41,595 chars cannot reach closed state because bounded recovery rejects contexts over 24,000 chars before attempting any recovery call, blocking correct merged work unless --force-close is used

The close gate misreports the cause of step-budget exhaustion as 'install the agents extra' when it should report the exception's own remedy, because recovery_failure_cause returns None for CompletionRecoveryError (which lacks an .outcome field at the point it is raised)
The criteria-char bound (32,000) incoherently exceeds the context-char bound (24,000), allowing a criteria set to pass all criteria bounds then fail on context

Raising the context cap to 100,000 chars covers both blocked tickets (9fd4 and 2932) with 2.4× headroom while keeping the per-criterion re-send cost bounded, and must be pinned against the criteria bound by invariant test

The remedy selection must be keyed on demonstrated failure cause (whether model calls ran) rather than exception type, and the size claim in diagnostic output must be conditional on the bound keys being present to avoid false 'None chars' messages
